design_status: v0.3 balancing proposal, approved direction but timing to be evaluated in Atari800

controls.move: joystick 1, up/down/left/right, one cardinal step each existing 8-frame player movement tick
controls.fire: FIRE + cardinal joystick direction, one blast on rising FIRE edge only; Fire blocks movement while held
controls.fire_without_direction: no blast; no movement until Fire released
controls.diagonal: use same deterministic single-axis priority as v0.2 movement; no diagonal blast
controls.fire_during_cooldown: no blast; release and press again after cooldown
controls.opening_sequence: START, FIRE scene transitions retained, unchanged

units.activation: 60 NTSC frames after Stage 1 begins; even if Billy has left dining
30 frames after Billy first enters kitchen
units.role: interceptor positioned ahead of the direct path

units.activation: 30 frames after Billy first enters storage

hazmat.door_follow_behavior: persistent unique worker IDs; follow one adjacent room at a time through linked D passage, never teleport across multiple rooms; no duplicates; preserve their timers, stun and positions when revisiting
hazmat.collision: CAUGHT when Billy overlaps a non-stunned worker; stunned worker can be passed through harmlessly
hazmat.chase: cardinal navigation on non-solid tiles; prioritize Billy if in same room; bounded pathfinding and regular turns; cannot pass walls/equipment; avoid freezing movement during search
hazmat.grace_only_for: collision with a worker that already occupies Billy's destination tile immediately on a room transition; choose another valid spawn tile first; do not grant immunity throughout a room

blast.geometry: one-tile-wide ray along one cardinal joystick direction starting at adjacent tile
blast.targeting: nearest first non-stunned or stunned hazmat worker along ray in current room; affect at most one
blast.knockback: each tile away must be in bounds and non-solid; stop before a solid obstacle; never shove through D to another room or through X to win
blast.visual: temporary distinctive directional gas-cloud glyph or tile highlight; restore underlying terrain after effect expires
blast.stun_collision: stunned worker cannot catch Billy; overlap allowed until stun ends, then if overlap persists resolve catch only after giving player one movement tick to leave
blast.pressure_meter: no indoor gas-pressure cost or meter yet; leave road gas rules untouched

other.layout: no room geometry/door changes; use exactly the three v0.2 40x22 maps

room_roles.kitchen: additional worker intercepts central travel corridor; plan a route or gas blast
room_roles.storage: third blocker near final exit, forcing a deliberate evade or gas blast

other.caught: same Stage 1 restart as v0.2, no lives loss
other.complete: same Stage Complete when storage X at (39,10), no Road 1
other.pacing: Record skilled and first-clear times from actual emulator tests; prior 70–105 second concept is aspirational only, not an enforced countdown

runtime_tests: three distinct enemies with bounded spawns
blast line of sight and occlusion
push to walls and map bounds
